privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: How FitStream AI handles your personal data
privacy.introText: FitStream AI respects your privacy. This policy explains what data we collect, how we use it, and your rights regarding your personal information.
privacy.dataCollectedText: We collect the following types of data:
privacy.dataHealthText: Workout logs, weight measurements, calorie intake, exercise counts, body metrics
privacy.dataPhotosText: Food photos and scale images you scan (processed for AI analysis, not stored permanently)
privacy.dataAccountText: If you sign in with Google: email address and profile name for sync purposes
privacy.dataUsageText: Anonymous app usage statistics to improve the service
privacy.use1: Provide AI-powered fitness and nutrition tracking
privacy.use2: Sync your progress across devices (if signed in)
privacy.use4: Improve our AI models and service quality
privacy.storageText: FitStream is offline-first. Your data is stored locally on your device. Cloud sync (optional) uses secure servers. Photos sent to AI are processed in real-time and not permanently stored.
privacy.thirdPartyGemini: For AI analysis of food, scales, and coaching. Subject to Google's privacy policy.
privacy.thirdPartyHealth: Optional sync with health platforms. Only data you explicitly choose to share is exchanged.
privacy.securityText: We implement industry-standard security measures including encryption in transit and at rest. However, no system is 100% secure.
privacy.rights4: Opt out of cloud sync at any time
privacy.childrenText: FitStream is not intended for children under 13. We do not knowingly collect data from children.
privacy.changesText: We may update this policy periodically. We will notify users of significant changes through the app.
privacy.contactText: For privacy-related questions, contact us via Telegram:
